budget_closure_rules_target_check.name: budget_closure_rules_target_check
budget_closure_rules_target_check.value:
(
        ("budget_closure_rules"."destination" = 'reallocation' and "budget_closure_rules"."target_budget_id" is not null and "budget_closure_rules"."savings_goal_id" is null)
        or ("budget_closure_rules"."destination" = 'goal' and "budget_closure_rules"."target_budget_id" is null and "budget_closure_rules"."savings_goal_id" is not null)
        or ("budget_closure_rules"."destination" = 'rollover' and "budget_closure_rules"."target_budget_id" = "budget_closure_rules"."budget_id" and "budget_closure_rules"."savings_goal_id" is null)
        or ("budget_closure_rules"."destination" = 'expire' and "budget_closure_rules"."target_budget_id" is null and "budget_closure_rules"."savings_goal_id" is null)
      )

        or ("budget_settlements"."destination" = 'expire' and "budget_settlements"."target_budget_id" is null and "budget_settlements"."savings_goal_id" is null and "budget_settlements"."target_period" is null)
      )

public.account_balances.definition: select "accounts"."id", "accounts"."user_id", "accounts"."name", "accounts"."type", "accounts"."currency", "accounts"."opening_balance", "accounts"."is_archived", "accounts"."created_at", "accounts"."updated_at", ("accounts"."opening_balance" + coalesce(sum("transactions"."amount"), 0))::bigint as "balance", count("transactions"."id")::int as "transaction_count" from "accounts" left join "transactions" on "transactions"."account_id" = "accounts"."id" group by "accounts"."id"
public.account_balances.name: account_balances

public.transaction_lines.definition: select "transactions"."id" as "transaction_id", "transactions"."user_id", "transactions"."account_id", "transactions"."kind", "transactions"."occurred_on", "transactions"."currency", case when "transaction_splits"."id" is null then "transactions"."category_id" else "transaction_splits"."category_id" end as "category_id", coalesce("transaction_splits"."amount", "transactions"."amount") as "amount" from "transactions" left join "transaction_splits" on "transaction_splits"."transaction_id" = "transactions"."id"
public.transaction_lines.name: transaction_lines
